instructions.privacy_note: Contact or credential-like spans are replaced with explicit placeholders; raw evidence hashes retain provenance without copying the redacted values.

sampling.method: Deterministic, source-stratified and engine-mention-stratified sample, with class strata for no-mention examples; adult, abuse-related, or romance-story copy and one-word UNKNOWN fragments were screened out, exact duplicate evidence is represented once per source, and SHA-256 ranks unique texts within each stratum using the recorded seed. The target was 60; the available unique Ouedkniss evidence capped the final sample at 59.
